description: Land Title Settlement Department - Egoda Uyama, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520217 (7570)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific corrections to land parcel information including extent measurements, ownership types, identity card numbers, and servitude rights for various land parcels across different districts. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land title registrations, property boundary details, and cadastral map references without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
